content:
I have built the premium streetwear e-commerce landing page for **Seu Marquinho**!

### Summary of Completed Work

1. **Next.js App Router Initialization**: Bootstrapped the project in the workspace root with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, ESLint, and a `src/` directory.
2. **Assets Configured**: Relocated the brand imagery to [public/PRODUTOS E LOGO/](file:///c:/Users/jorda/OneDrive/Documents/SITE%20SEU%20MARQUINHO/public/PRODUTOS%20E%20LOGO) using the actual `.PNG` extensions matching disk values to prevent Next.js compilation issues.
3. **Responsive Design System**: Set up typography styles (Inter), global properties, custom scrollbar tracks, and dark streetwear palettes in [src/app/globals.css](file:///c:/Users/jorda/OneDrive/Documents/SITE%20SEU%20MARQUINHO/src/app/globals.css).
4. **Layout Setup & SEO**: Created metadata titles, keywords, and description wrappers in [src/app/layout.tsx](file:///c:/Users/jorda/OneDrive/Documents/SITE%20SEU%20MARQUINHO/src/app/layout.tsx).
5. **Interactive Landing Page**: Developed a comprehensive landing page in [src/app/page.tsx](file:///c:/Users/jorda/OneDrive/Documents/SITE%20SEU%20MARQUINHO/src/app/page.tsx) featuring a dynamic Hero showcase, a Category Bento Grid, responsive Product grids, a Quality manifesto, an interactive **Cart Slide Drawer**, and a live **Search Dialog Modal** utilizing Framer Motion animations.
6. **Build Verification**: Executed `npm run build` to confirm compiled code health and eliminate typescript or next-route warning variables.

For a detailed breakdown of the styling, animations, and verification, please refer to the [walkthrough.md](file:///C:/Users/jorda/.gemini/antigravity/brain/d50e19db-2019-4149-927b-196b859292c5/walkthrough.md) artifact. You can also view the updated checklist in the [task.md](file:///C:/Users/jorda/.gemini/antigravity/brain/d50e19db-2019-4149-927b-196b859292c5/task.md) file.
